title: OfferCreate
key_points: The OfferCreate transaction creates an offer to buy or sell XRP or other digital assets.
It requires a valid account domain and an unsigned form of the TransactionAuth
The fee is in the range of 20 to 500 drops, with a minimum balance requirement.
The offer can be created by either the offerer's or the tee's account.
The OfferCreate transaction has a maximum lifespan of one year.
limitations: The scope and detail of this source may be limited to internal documentation for the Ripple protocol.
Some details may require additional sources to fully understand the mechanics and use cases.
asserts: The OfferCreate transaction allows users to create offers to buy or sell XRP or other digital assets within the Ripple protocol.
